summary: Frontend-only testing of new Wizard (Guidata) mode with 5 steps + toggle Guidata/Libera in Progetto Oliveto. All 12 review scenarios verified via Playwright. Wizard is active by default, steps 2-5 locked until perimeter closes, drawing then closing perimeter auto-advances to step 2, all QuickBig +/- controls update values, obstacle sheet opens from step 3, optimize azimuth shows toast, save flushes with success toast, PDF/GeoJSON buttons present, collapse toggles content, toggle to Libera hides wizard and shows Toolbar with all 9 Italian toolbar buttons. Backend not tested (no changes per request).

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (a11y warning, not blocking)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ObstacleSheet/NetworkSheet DialogContent to remove the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Planner.jsx is 891 lines — could be split (drawing/wizard/backup/exports concerns) for maintainability.

In WizardPanel, `canNext` hides the Next button on step 5 which is fine, but on step 1 with an unclosed perimeter it also hides Next entirely; consider showing it disabled with a tooltip explaining why so users understand the flow.

QuickBig uses toFixed based on step<0.5 → for step=0.5 it renders 1 decimal, but interRow step is 0.5 → OK; wiz-inter-plant step 0.1 → OK; wiz-emitter-spacing step 0.05 currently uses 2 decimals due to step<0.5 — verify readability.
closeField advances wizard from step 1 to step 2, but if the user was on any other step and re-closes/imports, wizard step is unchanged; expected behaviour per spec.
seed_data_creation: One test field ‘Campo 1’ auto-created on load (guest); closed with 4 vertices during test near Brindisi (map default center).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All wizard flows (5 steps + toggle) work end-to-end. Only minor a11y warning from Radix Dialog (ObstacleSheet). Verified against public URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. No backend changes were part of this iteration.
